text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Nakayama Festa and 
Tosen Jordan running on the training 
track.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew! Thanks a bunch! Seriously saved my 
life there~♪

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to enjoy what you'd call a 
'for real' run, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What? So you're saying you had fun 
too? Well then, fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'll pay you back for this later! 
Look forward to it~~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nakayama-senpaaaai!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What is it, keep it down.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I was watching your run just now, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A heat so intense you'd never guess it was 
training! A nail-biting, tactical showdown 
just like a real race! It was truly—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Supreme power! Ultimate strength! Total 
frenzy! El is deeply, deeply moved, 
desuuu!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Please, next time run with El just like 
that... no! Give me something even better, 
desu!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Got a big race coming up or something? Why 
are you asking for a side-by-side run that 
feels like a real match?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! To seize the title of world's 
strongest, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
An overseas race where top competitors 
from all over the world gather! Standing 
at the top there is my goal, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Winning overseas is surely going to be 
extremely difficult, desu. Even getting 
the chance to challenge it isn't easy!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's why! Even more than now! I must 
polish myself further, desuuu!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Seizing a limited opportunity, huh... I 
see, that sounds pretty enticing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Right-handed 2,400 meters. Good with you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, Nakayama Festa and El Condor 
Pasa began their side-by-side run, but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I'm calling it.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿Qué? Um... Nakayama-senpai, what's the 
matter, desu?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Nothing's the matter. Total buzzkill. Hey, 
El...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Are you running for real?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course! I'm running with everything 
I've got!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm serious, I run against fast 
runners! I revamp my training routines! I 
do so much every single day, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All so I can hold my own when racing 
overseas!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but it doesn't click with me. Find 
someone else for your training partner.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on a second, please! Why is El no 
good, but Jordan-senpai is, desu?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Running with her had me on edge... That's 
all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~, that doesn't make any sense at all 
desu~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Don't hold out on me, explain! I'm begging 
you here~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? Anyway, if you can't get fired 
up, it ain't a real match. See ya.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Just what on earth is El missing, 
thenーー?!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa's cry echoed emptily across 
the course.
